extra.source: OSM 850261588 (the pit lane, Voie des stands), its own nodes from the run up past Antony Noghes to its last 25 m beside the start straight - its entry from Avenue du Port, just after Rascasse (mapped from the corner apex, inside the hairpin: at the game widths the lane end lay in the corner island, off the road) (the game merge eases it in from there: mapped on to the straight it met the swimming pool road at the game widths)
the harbour relation (OSM 2221179, Port Hercule): its quays ring (166624054 + 166624056, closed across the harbour mouth as 224205565)

the Fairmont hairpin re-laid for the game road (13 m at 1/2 scale): the mapped legs (OSM 568187257, 4230007) meet at a 28 degree V a 13 m road cannot turn in; a U of 11 game m radius, its legs 22 m apart, from the Mirabeau node to the Mirabeau Bas node (aerial photographs: the hairpin round the hotel corner)

the swimming pool's second chicane and the run to Rascasse (OSM 1081401615) eased toward the harbour - up to 12 real m at the chicane, 16 along the pit lane - where it runs 16-18 real m from the pit lane (game: the 13 m road and the 9 m lane had no room for a wall between); its own nodes otherwise
the pit building east of the pit lane (aerial photographs, ESRI World Imagery: the garages along the lane between the start straight and the swimming pool); OSM maps it as part of the quay

a grandstand of the race (the start straight, opposite the pits): the circuit's grandstand map (f1monaco.com, oversteer48.com), placed by the aerial photographs - OSM maps none (they are put up for the race)
a grandstand of the race (Tabac, on the harbour): the circuit's grandstand map (f1monaco.com, oversteer48.com), placed by the aerial photographs - OSM maps none (they are put up for the race)
